project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child shows a family tree with names, threads a small necklace for a family member, shows how to call home on a toy phone and says how they reuse bottles or bags at home.

activities.goal_en: Narrate a real-life story from home in the right order.
activities.prompt_en: Tell us what your family did on Sunday. What happened first? Then?
steps_en: Tell your own short story as a model, using first, then, at the end.
Ask the child to tell their story.
Help with questions: who was there? where?
The child draws one moment of the story.
observe_en: Tells two or three events in order.
Uses first, then, at the end.
Speaks to the group with confidence.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 33 (Storytelling: Narrating a story), p. 60; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Read pictures of kitchen utensils and say what they are used for.
activities.prompt_en: Look at the picture. What is this? What do we do with it?
steps_en: Show pictures or real utensils: pot, plate, cup, spoon, knife, mortar.
Name each one together.
Say what we use it for.
Make a picture album of the kitchen.
observe_en: Says that knives are for adults.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 36 (Reading: Picture reading), p. 63; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Write one’s own name with a capital first letter.
activities.prompt_en: Your name starts with a capital letter. Let us write it together.
steps_en: Write the child’s name on a card as a model.
Trace it with a finger.
Trace it with a pencil on dotted letters.
Write it alone under the model.
observe_en: Writes the first letter as a capital.
Writes all the letters in order.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 37 (Writing: Letters and numbers), p. 64; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Say in French one’s name and where one lives.
activities.prompt_en: In French: “Je m’appelle Fon. J’habite à Bamenda.” Where do you live?
steps_en: Say the two sentences with your name and town.
The child repeats with their own.
Practise with a puppet.
Add: “Ma maman s’appelle…”.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 38 (French: Se présenter), p. 65; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.prompt_en: Mummy has 8 groundnut balls for two children. Give one to each child until there are none left.
steps_en: Put 8 objects on the table and two plates.
Give one to each plate in turn.
Count what each plate has.
Try with 6 and 10 objects.
observe_en: Gives one at a time to each plate.
Checks that both plates have the same.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 39 (Mathematics: Mathematical operations), p. 66–67; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: 8 groundnut balls shared equally by 2 children. How many for each child?
interactive.explanation_en: Give one to each child in turn: each child gets 4.

activities.goal_en: Simulate the use of a phone keypad to call someone.
activities.prompt_en: With a phone, we can talk to someone far away. Let us press the numbers to call Grandma.
steps_en: Show a phone keypad (a toy or a drawing).
Find and press the numbers of a written number.
Act the call: “Hello, Grandma! It is Ngum.”
Say: we use the phone with an adult’s permission.
observe_en: Says that phones are used with permission.
materials_en: a toy phone or a keypad drawing
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 40 (Information and Communication Technologies: The keypad of a communication device), p. 68–70; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Where does the tap water come from?
activities.goal_en: Identify plumbing materials and build a small water channel.
activities.prompt_en: The plumber brings water to our house with pipes. Let us make a little pipe with bamboo or bottles.
steps_en: Show a tap and talk about the pipes behind it.
Name the plumber’s tools.
Make a channel with cut bottles or bamboo.
Pour water and watch it flow.
observe_en: Builds a channel that carries water.
Says that water must not be wasted.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 42 (Science and Technology: Plumbing), p. 73–75; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Present the family: parents, grandparents, brothers and sisters.
activities.prompt_en: Here is a tree. On the branches, let us put Grandma, Grandpa, Mummy, Daddy, and you!
steps_en: Draw a big tree.
Stick or draw the family members on it.
Name each person and say how they are related.
Present the tree to friends.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 44 (Citizenship: Self-introduction), p. 77; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Follow fire safety rules at home.
activities.prompt_en: Matches and fire are for adults. If you see fire, shout for help and go out.
steps_en: Show matches and a lighter (adult keeps them).
Say: we never play with matches.
Practise: shout “Fire!” and go outside to an adult.
Show where matches are kept, out of reach.
observe_en: Shouts for help in the drill.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 47 (Safety Education: Home safety), p. 80; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Recycle and reuse waste with creativity.
activities.prompt_en: An empty bottle can become a pencil holder! Let us reuse things instead of throwing them away.
steps_en: Show clean empty bottles, tins and boxes.
Ask: what can we make with them?
Make a pencil holder from a bottle.
Sort what can be reused and what goes to the bin.
observe_en: Proposes a new use for an object.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 46 (Environmental Education: Recycling waste), p. 79; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Thread beads to make a necklace.
activities.prompt_en: Thread the beads one by one: red, yellow, red, yellow…
steps_en: Give a string with a knot at one end.
Thread big beads, following a colour pattern.
Tie the ends (adult).
Offer the necklace to a family member.
materials_en: big beads or dried seeds with holes
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 52 (Handwork: Practice sessions), p. 85; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Hop on one foot and on two feet with control.
activities.prompt_en: Hop on one foot to the line, then hop back on the other foot!
steps_en: Show hopping on one foot.
Hop on two feet into circles drawn on the ground.
Play a hopping game in turns.
Rest and shake the legs.
observe_en: Hops on one foot a few times.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 53 (Physical Education and Sports: Athletics), p. 86; theme 3: The family and home (table 13, p. 37)

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Tells a real-life story from home.
Names family members on a tree.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery Two tables, cited and not reproduced.
